decisions.reason: Although more peripheral than the machinery products, the accelerator fits the firm's advisory and partnership capabilities and can strengthen absorptive capacity by giving access to external green-technology knowledge, so it is more likely to be retained than dropped.

As a stated flagship with a clear sustainability logic and links to the firm's recycling know-how and R&D base, management is likely to keep it on the market while learning and refining its commercial application.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm's established modular waste-treatment expertise and is highlighted as a focus product, so existing knowledge and engineering capabilities strongly support continued commercialization.

A mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm's core technical, manufacturing and service capabilities, making it the kind of related product that a growing German machinery firm would usually continue to back.
